messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — RC candidate built from main and pushed to the staging registry. Draft release notes here: https://redwood.internal/rn/rc-v2.4-rc1.
Need sign-off on pin strategy and rollback criteria for the 2hr change window tomorrow (03/19 UTC). Proposing: pin hosted + dedicated to `v2.4-rc1`, fallback to `v2.3`. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 30m. @Liam Patel @Ashley Rivera @Raj Singh - any objections?

Liam Patel: 👍 overall. Recommend smaller initial blast: 2% for 15m, then 10% for 15m, then promote to 50% if metrics OK. Also suggest we keep embeddings route on holdback for first 24h (seen regressions previously).

Ashley Rivera: Release notes look good. Please add a short note about tokenization behavior change with older tokenizers (known issue). I'll prepare the internal announcement copy once RN final.

Raj Singh: SRE check from staging: p50 42ms, p95 210ms, error rate 0.11% — nothing alarming. Rollback play: if p95 increases >40% vs baseline OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m, we trigger immediate rollback to `v2.3` and notify paging.
Also: keep canary to <=10% for first 30m for safety.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan scheduled. Canary rollout config:
```
canary_steps:
  - 2% for 15m
  - 10% for 15m
  - 50% gradual promote
target_regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
rollback_image: sha256:abcdef1234567890
```
Deploy started? Not yet — waiting on final RN pin.

ops-bot: Metric snapshot (staging): p50=45ms p95=220ms errors=0.12% traffic=baseline. Alerting hooks set for p95 and error rate thresholds. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollout

Maya Chen: Thanks — I'll update the RN with the exact thresholds and the tokenization note. Proposed internal announcement (short): "RC v2.4-rc1 rolling to hosted + dedicated tomorrow during change window; canary staged; rollback plan in place. Expect a brief degradation window if triggered. Contact SRE oncall for escalations." Anyone want to edit copy?

Ashley Rivera: I'll own the internal announce posting and pin RN in #eng-releases. Will post ~30m before window and include rollback bullets + link to runbook.

Liam Patel: I'll watch dashboards during rollout and take action if any trend starts to creep up.

Raj Singh: Oncall acked and will shadow first 60m. If we hit rollback thresholds we flip pin to `v2.3` and start incident channel.

Maya Chen: Great — final action items: 1) Ashley posts internal announce + RN pin, 2) Raj watches metrics and owns rollback, 3) Liam monitors app metrics, 4) I will update RN with canary table and known issue. Thanks all :thumbsup:
